book.title: El cocinero de su majestad: Memorias del tiempo de Felipe III
book.author: Manuel Fernández y González

acts.instructions: `chapter` is a chapter of a novel, and `the story so far` tells what a reader knows on reaching it. What does its main character do in it?

criteria.expected: What the story so far would lead one to expect of them
criteria.fitting: Something the story so far did not lead one to expect, and which fits what is known of them
criteria.unfitting: Something the story so far did not lead one to expect, and which does not fit what is known of them

reveals.instructions: `chapter` is a chapter of a novel, and `the story so far` tells what a reader knows on reaching it. What does it show of its people?
criteria: The chapter shows its people as the story so far had shown them
The chapter adds a trait or a detail to someone the reader already knew
The chapter shows a side of someone that the story so far had not shown, and that changes how the reader sees them

torn.instructions: `chapter` is a chapter of a novel, and `the story so far` tells what a reader knows on reaching it. Is anyone in it in two minds?
criteria: Nobody in the chapter is in two minds about anything
A character hesitates a moment before doing what they do
A character is torn between two things they want or believe, and the chapter dwells on it

sides.instructions: `chapter` is a chapter of a novel, and `the story so far` tells what a reader knows on reaching it. Whose side is the reader on in its main conflict?

criteria.none: There is no conflict between people in the chapter
criteria.one: One side is in the right and the other in the wrong
criteria.both: Both sides have a real claim on the reader's sympathy

pays.instructions: `chapter` is a chapter of a novel, and `the story so far` tells what a reader knows on reaching it. What does it do with what the story so far had left pending?
criteria: The chapter touches nothing that the story so far had left pending
The chapter moves forward something that the story so far had left pending
The chapter settles something that the story so far had left pending

remarks: What each chapter does to the people of the story, asked with what the reader knows so far beside it, from the reading notes of google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite.
